journey.title: Produce a hero backdrop with no model and no spend
journey.purpose: The core loop, and the one that must work on any machine with no network, no GPU, and no account: find a procedural style, bind it to a brand, render candidates, confirm the headline stays readable over the image, and release it for a landing page to reference.

steps.intent: Narrow the catalog to ambient styles that suit a full-bleed hero and cost nothing to run.
steps.via: axis facets for role, placement, and strategy

steps.intent: Confirm the style's treatment chain, copy-safe region, and contrast threshold before committing to it.
See exactly what will run, and see the brand palette slots resolve to concrete inks, before anything executes.
Understand that some candidates are unusable despite looking good, because the measured worst pixel under the headline falls below the threshold.
Discover that the chosen candidate passes at desktop but fails as a mobile crop, before it reaches a page rather than after.
Accept the computed minimum scrim that brings the mobile crop above threshold, and see the before-and-after.
Copy the stable identifier the landing page will reference, with the copy-safe region and measured contrast attached to it.
